_comment: Human-curated semantic descriptions for major LMS tables. Used by the schema retriever to enrich table cards in the vector store so that 'attendance' queries find student_attendences, etc.
students: Master student records. Holds admission number, roll number, names, contact info, parent/guardian info, address, DOB, gender, blood group, religion. school_house_id links to school_houses (Red/Blue/Green/Yellow House). One row per registered student.
school_houses: School house groups (Red House, Blue House, Green House, Yellow House). Join students.school_house_id = school_houses.id; column house_name.
student_session: Maps a student to their class, section, hostel room, and transport route for a given academic session. Join here to find a student's current class, section, hostel, or vehicle.
classes: List of all class/grade names (e.g., 'Grade 1', '5', 'Class 10'). Used everywhere to filter by grade.
sections: List of section names (A, B, etc.) for each class.
class_sections: Many-to-many bridge between classes and sections.
staff: Master staff/employee records. department column is FK to department.id; designation is FK to staff_designation.id. Has name, surname, email, contact_no, joining_date, is_active.
department: HR department master list. Columns: id, department_name. Join staff.department = department.id for department names and headcount.
staff_designation: Job titles/designations (Principal, Teacher, etc.). Join staff.designation = staff_designation.id.
roles: System roles (Admin, Teacher, Accountant, etc.). staff_roles links staff to roles.
staff_roles: Many-to-many: staff_id + role_id. Use to count teachers vs other roles.
Bridge table: which roles a staff member holds (a staff can have multiple roles).
roles: Role catalog (Teacher, Admin, Accountant, Librarian, Principal, etc.).
class_teacher: Bridge: which staff member is the class teacher / subject teacher for a given class+section.
teacher_subjects: Bridge: which subjects a teacher is assigned to teach.
subjects: Catalog of subjects (Math, Science, English, etc.).
subject_groups: Logical grouping of subjects for a class.
subject_group_subjects: Bridge: subjects inside each subject group.
subject_group_class_sections: Bridge: which class+section a subject group is assigned to.
subject_timetable: Weekly class timetable: day, time slot, subject, teacher, class, section.
student_attendences: Daily student attendance records (one row per student per day). Joins via student_session_id. Has in_time, out_time, remark.
attendence_type: Catalog of attendance status codes (Present, Absent, Late, Half-Day). Has type code and long_lang_name display name.
staff_attendance: Daily staff attendance records (punch in/out). Joins via staff_id.
staff_attendance_type: Catalog of staff attendance status codes.
student_behaviour: Catalog of behaviour incident types (Late Submission, Fighting, Excellent Work). Has title, description, point value.
student_incidents: Actual behaviour incidents logged against a specific student (joins to student_behaviour for incident type).
student_incident_comments: Threaded comments on a behaviour incident.
student_fees_master: Fee invoices owed by each student (one row per fee item per student).
student_fees_deposite: Fee payments received against a student_fees_master invoice. Has amount, payment_mode, payment_date.
offline_fees_payments: Offline bank fee payment requests. Join student_session via student_session_id (NOT student_id). is_active: '0'=Pending, '1'=Approved, '2'=Rejected.
fee_groups: Fee group catalog (Tuition, Bus, Hostel, etc.).
fee_session_groups_classes: Bridge: which fee groups apply to which class.
onlineexam: Online exam catalog (dates/times only). NOT the main /admin/examresult marks page — use exam_group_exam_results for school exam marks. NOT the Online Course addon — use online_courses for LMS courses.
onlineexam_questions: Links questions.id to onlineexam.id when questions are assigned to an online exam.
questions: Online examination question bank (/admin/question). class_id FK to classes (grade), subject_id, question_type (singlechoice, multichoice, true_false, descriptive), level, opt_a–opt_e, correct.
onlineexam_results: Student attempts and scores for online exams only.
online_courses: Online Course addon catalog (title, status, teacher_id, category_id). status='1' means active/published. NOT onlineexam quizzes.
online_course_exam_question: Online Course question bank. question_type: singlechoice, multichoice, true_false, descriptive. question_tag FK to online_course_tag.id.
online_course_tag: Question tags for online course question bank. Tag label column is tag_name (NOT tag).
online_course_exam: Quizzes/exams attached to an online course (course_id FK). is_quiz flag. NOT the same as onlineexam table.
course_progress: Tracks lesson/quiz/assignment completion per student or guest for an online course (course_id FK to online_courses).
online_course_payment: Paid enrollments for online courses (online_courses_id FK). Links student_id or guest_id.
lesson: Lesson plan header per subject group class section (name, subject_group_subject_id, subject_group_class_sections_id).
topic: Topics under a lesson with status (0=incomplete, 1=complete) and complete_date. NOT online course topics.
subject_group_class_sections: Links class+section to a subject_group for the active session.
subject_group_subjects: Subjects inside a subject group; id is used as subject_id in lesson plan forms.
exam_groups: Exam group header (name, exam_type). Parent of batch exams on /admin/examresult.
exam_group_class_batch_exams: Individual exams inside a group (column exam = exam title). Filter students via exam_group_class_batch_exam_students.
exam_group_class_batch_exam_students: Students enrolled in an exam for a class/section/session. Links student_session_id.
exam_group_class_batch_exam_subjects: Subjects in an exam with max_marks, date_from, time_from.
exam_group_exam_results: Published marks per student per subject (get_marks, attendence, note). Primary exam RESULTS table for /admin/examresult.
exam_results: Legacy exam marks (pairs with exam_schedules and exams). Use if exam_group_* tables are empty.
exam_schedules: Legacy per-subject exam schedule (date_of_exam, full_marks, passing_marks). Join exam_results for marks.
exams: Legacy exam name catalog (pairs with exam_schedules).
exam_schedule: Alias/legacy schedule rows — prefer exam_schedules for offline exams.
mark_sheet: Optional marksheet template data; main UI marks are in exam_group_exam_results.
enquiry: Front-office admission enquiries (walk-in / phone enquiries from prospects). Has name, contact, source, status, follow_up_date. Not the same as online_admissions.
online_admissions: Submitted online admission application forms from the public website. Has reference_no, applicant name, mobile, email, form_status, is_enroll.
visitors_book: Front-office visitor log. Records visitor name, purpose, person being met, contact, in_time, out_time.
phone_call_log: Front-office phone call log (incoming/outgoing). Has name, phone, call_type, description, follow_up_date.
complaint: Logged complaints / grievances (front office). Table name is complaint (not complain). Columns: name, complaint_type, description, action_taken, assigned, note, date.
leave_request: Student leave applications (apply_date, from_date, to_date, reason, status).
staff_leave_request: Staff leave applications (apply_date, from_date, to_date, reason, status).
homework: Homework assignments for a class+section/subject. Has homework_date, submit_date, description. Submissions are in submit_assignment (not homework_students).
submit_assignment: Student homework submissions linked to homework.id (student_id, docs, message).
courses: Online course catalog (LMS addon). Has title, category, status (draft/published/archived), teacher_id.
enrollments: Student enrollments into online courses with status and progress_percent.
lessons: Lessons inside an online course. Has video_url, subtitles, duration_seconds.
assignments: Assignments attached to a course/lesson. Has due_date, max_score.
submissions: Student assignment submissions with score, feedback, status.
quiz_results: Per-student quiz attempt records with score and max_score.
notice_board: School-wide notice board entries (general announcements, separate from course announcements).
notice_roles: Bridge: which roles a notice is published to.
events: School events / calendar. Has from_date, to_date, description.
books: Library book catalog. Has book_title, book_number, ISBN, publisher, book_category.
book_issues: Library book issue/return records. Joins to books and libarary_members (member_id). is_returned 0=out, 1=returned. return_date for returns.
libarary_members: Library member registry linking students/staff to library_card_no. member_type is student or teacher.
books: Library book catalog — book_title, book_no, author, qty.
content_types: Download Center content type catalog (PDF, Video, Doc, etc.) — name and description.
upload_contents: Download Center uploaded files. Join content_types via content_type_id. real_name, file_type, date.
share_contents: Download Center shared content batches — title, share_date, valid_upto, created_by.
share_upload_contents: Links shared batches to upload_contents items — use for share counts and type distribution.
video_tutorial: Download Center video tutorials — title, video_link, vid_title, created_at, created_by. Filter by YEARWEEK(created_at) for this week.
video_tutorial_class_sections: Links video tutorials to class_sections (grade/section visibility).
online_course_lesson: Online Course addon lessons. lesson_type='video' for video lessons; created_date, video_url, duration, lesson_title.
hostel_room_type: Catalog of room types (Single, Double, Dormitory).
transport_vehicle: Vehicle catalog (vehicle_no, model, driver_name, driver_contact, driver_licence).
transport_route_vehicle: Bridge: vehicles assigned to routes with fare.
item: Inventory item catalog. Join item_category via item_category_id. Has name, unit, description, created_at (when item was added), optional date column.
item_stock: Inventory stock entries (quantity received). Columns: item_id, quantity, date, purchase_price, store_id, supplier_id.
item_category: Inventory categories (e.g. Laboratory, Sports). Column item_category is the category name.
item_issue: Inventory items issued to staff. issue_date, issue_to (staff.id), quantity, is_returned, return_date.
income: Income / revenue ledger. Columns: name (income head/category label), amount, date, invoice_no, description. Filter by MONTH(date) for period reports.
expenses: Expense ledger. Columns: name (expense head/category label), amount, date, invoice_no, description. GROUP BY name for category breakdowns.
staff_payslip: Monthly staff payslip records. Columns: month (English name e.g. 'April'), year, basic, total_allowance, total_deduction, net_salary, payment_date, status. Filter by sp.month AND sp.year — NOT staff_payroll.
staff_attendance: Daily staff punch attendance. Join staff_attendance_type for status labels. Filter by sa.date or MONTH/YEAR.
staff_leave_request: Staff leave applications. Columns: date (applied), leave_from, leave_to, leave_days, leave_type_id, status — NOT apply_date/from_date.
holiday_type: Configured holiday type catalog (type, is_default). NOT the languages table.
gmeet: Google Meet live classes addon. gmeet.date is scheduled datetime; purpose='class'. Participant counts in gmeet_history.
gmeet_history: Gmeet join history — student_id and staff_id for participant counts.
certificate_issue: Records of certificates issued to students.
id_card: Generated ID cards (for students or staff).
student_promotion: Records of student promotion from one class to another at session end.
student_disable_reason: Why a student account was disabled (transfer, dropout, graduation).
sessions: Academic session catalog (e.g., '2024-2025'). is_active='yes' marks the current session.
languages: System UI language catalog with short_code and is_active.
users: Generic user accounts (separate from staff/students depending on deployment).
_unmapped_table_default: An LMS table — use only if its name clearly matches the user's question.
